title: Protocol Before Architecture: code, out-of-fold predictions and analysis scripts for patient-wise evaluation on BreaKHis
description:
Code and results accompanying the manuscript Protocol Before Architecture: Data Leakage, Variance and Trustworthiness in Breast Cancer Histopathology Classification (under review).

Five architectures (a bidirectional cross-attention CNN–Transformer hybrid, its concatenation ablation, ConvNeXt-Tiny, Swin-Tiny and ResNet-50) were trained under patient-wise five-fold cross-validation at all four BreaKHis magnifications (20 runs), plus four image-wise runs that measure patient-level leakage. The archive contains the training notebook and source code, including executable patient-disjointness assertions; the out-of-fold predictions of all 20 runs (one row per image); and scripts that recompute every statistic, table value and figure in the manuscript from those predictions without retraining.

The BreaKHis images are not included; they are available from the original authors (Spanhol et al., IEEE Trans Biomed Eng 2016).
